claim_text: On June 7, 2024, after a six-week federal jury trial in United States v. Abdiaziz Shafii Farah et al., No. 22-CR-124, Abdiaziz Shafii Farah, Mohamed Jama Ismail, Abdimajid Mohamed Nur, Mukhtar Mohamed Shariff, and Hayat Mohamed Nur were convicted. USAO-MN reports the guilty-count breakdown as follows: Abdiaziz Farah — conspiracy to commit wire fraud (1), wire fraud (6), conspiracy to commit federal programs bribery (1), federal programs bribery (2), conspiracy to commit money laundering (1), money laundering (11), and false statements in a passport application (1); Ismail — conspiracy to commit wire fraud (1), conspiracy to commit money laundering (1), and money laundering (1); Abdimajid Nur — conspiracy to commit wire fraud (1), wire fraud (4), conspiracy to commit money laundering (1), and money laundering (4); Shariff — conspiracy to commit wire fraud (1), wire fraud (1), conspiracy to commit money laundering (1), and money laundering (1); Hayat Nur — conspiracy to commit wire fraud (1) and wire fraud (2).
